description: Path to the Unix Domain Socket for the API server. Under jailer, automatically remapped into the chroot.
MicroVM identifier. Surfaced in metrics and logs for orchestrator correlation.
Pre-load a full VM config JSON. The microVM auto-starts after parsing — no API calls needed. Useful for headless / one-shot orchestrators.
Disable the API server entirely. Only meaningful with --config-file. Saves resources and removes the API attack surface.
Disable seccomp filters. DEVELOPMENT ONLY — production deployments MUST keep seccomp enabled. Pairs with --gdb-socket since GDB syscalls are blocked by default filter.
Override the embedded seccomp filter with a custom seccompiler-bpf-compiled file. Use to permit additional syscalls (e.g., for custom build/debug; never for prod).
Emit a boot-timer metric on first guest jiffy. Useful for measuring the boot-time budget (target: ≤125 ms with serial console disabled).
Enable in-guest GDB stub on a Unix socket. Must be paired with KVM_SET_GUEST_DEBUG support. Typically requires --no-seccomp because the default filter blocks GDB-required syscalls.
Maximum API request body size. Raise for orchestrators that PUT large CPU templates or MMDS payloads.
Maximum MMDS payload size. Distinct from --http-api-max-payload-size; this caps how large the MMDS data store can grow.
Enables KVM PTP support in the guest kernel — exposes /dev/ptp0 driven by host clock via cheap paravirt calls. Recommended NTP source at scale (avoids per-guest network NTP traffic).

Tells Linux to reset CPUs via the i8042 keyboard controller reset line on reboot. Firecracker emulates i8042 just enough to detect this and terminate the process. Required for `reboot` inside x86 guests to cleanly tear down the microVM.
On panic, immediately reboot (and thus, via reboot=k, terminate Firecracker). Avoids zombie microVMs after guest kernel panic.
Skip PCI bus probing — Firecracker has no PCI bus, so this saves boot time. Default in Firecracker's recommended boot_args.
Routes guest kernel printks to the serial console. NOT in default boot_args because console output adds significant boot time. Add for debugging — production should leave off.

Min free memory the kernel keeps reserved. Raise (e.g., 256 MiB) on Firecracker hosts to combat memory fragmentation that causes 'fc_vmm: page allocation failure' errors during high-rate microVM creation.
Number of 2MiB hugepages to reserve. Required if any microVM uses machine-config.huge_pages=2M. Reserve ahead of microVM scheduling to avoid mid-boot allocation failures.
Per-process FD limit. Each Firecracker holds 20+ FDs (eventfd-heavy). For dense hosts running many microVMs in one process tree, raise via /etc/security/limits.conf or systemd LimitNOFILE.

Static CPU template options: T2, T2A, T2CL, T2S, V1N1, C3. T2 is Intel-broad; T2A AMD-broad; T2CL Cascade Lake-baseline; T2S Skylake-baseline; V1N1 Graviton2-class; C3 Cascade Lake conservative. DEPRECATED in favor of PUT /cpu-config custom templates.
